criteria.description: Continuation coherently completes the prefix 'Groggily got out of bed. Blindly ' into a single grammatical standalone tweet, without repeating the prefix, adding a link/hashtag, or discussing the task.

Preserves the groggy, casual, low-energy stance and voice; informality, lowercase, '..', slashes, fragments are acceptable when they fit, and a distinctive concrete image or joke is stronger than stock hyperbole like 'most miserable experience ever'.
Is economical and natural at roughly 15 words (10-20 words acceptable) and keeps the full tweet including prefix at or under 280 characters.
